function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a given user by their ID. It filters the mandates based on their status if provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom mandates are being fetched.

status.description: The status of the mandates to fetch. If not specified, mandates of all statuses are returned.
